role.zh: 研究员 · 博士生导师

institution.zh: 中国科学院广州能源研究所
institution.en: Guangzhou Institute of Energy Conversion, Chinese Academy of Sciences

intro.zh: 主要从事废弃物处理与定向资源化（退役光伏层压件高效解离、可腐有机固废处理与资源化利用、碳一原料高值转化与利用）、功能材料开发和生物新技术（功能材料定向构筑、炭材料-微生物耦合强化胞外电子传递）的理论及技术研究。
intro.en: My research focuses on the fundamentals and technologies of waste treatment and targeted valorization, functional materials, and biotechnology. Specific interests include efficient delamination of end-of-life photovoltaic modules, treatment and valorization of biodegradable organic waste, conversion of C1 feedstocks into high-value products, tailored synthesis of functional materials, and enhanced extracellular electron transfer through carbon material–microbe coupling.

title.zh: 可腐有机固废生化转化

subtitle.zh: 从碳一原料到微生物链延长
subtitle.en: From C1 feedstocks to microbial chain elongation

text.zh: 关注碳一原料的定向生化转化与微生物链延长，探索碳资源向燃料及高值化学品转化的路径。
text.en: Exploring directed biochemical conversion of C1 feedstocks and microbial chain elongation to produce fuels and value-added chemicals.

question.zh: 如何提升碳资源生物转化过程的效率、选择性与稳定性？
question.en: How can biological carbon conversion become more efficient, selective and robust?

methods.zh: 微生物转化 · 过程调控 · 热力学分析
methods.en: Microbial conversion · Process regulation · Thermodynamic analysis

title.zh: 材料与微生物相互作用

subtitle.zh: 理解电子传递，改善生物转化

text.zh: 研究生物炭、石墨烯等材料与微生物过程的耦合，关注胞外电子传递及环境胁迫下的转化表现。
text.en: Investigating how biochar, graphene and related materials interact with microbial processes, with a focus on extracellular electron transfer and conversion under environmental stress.

question.zh: 材料的性质如何影响微生物电子传递及转化过程？
question.en: How do material properties influence microbial electron transfer and conversion?

methods.zh: 功能材料 · 微生物群落 · 电子传递
methods.en: Functional materials · Microbial communities · Electron transfer

title.zh: 退役光伏组件循环利用

subtitle.zh: 退役光伏层压件的解离与循环利用
subtitle.en: Delamination and recycling of photovoltaic laminates

text.zh: 围绕退役光伏层压件的热化学解离，研究组分相互作用与污染物迁移，为资源回收与过程优化提供依据。
text.en: Studying thermochemical delamination of end-of-life photovoltaic laminates, including component interactions and pollutant migration, to inform resource recovery and process optimization.

question.zh: 如何理解光伏层压件解离中的组分作用与氟迁移？
question.en: How do component interactions influence delamination and fluorine migration?

methods.zh: 热化学转化 · 反应机理 · 产物分析
methods.en: Thermochemical conversion · Reaction mechanisms · Product analysis

publications.title: Thermochemical recycling of end-of-life photovoltaic laminates using pyrolysis: Interaction mechanisms and fluorine migration and transformation
publications.authors: Yuanzhong Zhang, Jing Gu, Benteng Wu, Jianwei Wang, Haoran Yuan

note.zh: 关注封装层与背板共热解的相互作用及氟迁移，为光伏层压件回收和污染物管理提供依据。
note.en: Examines co-pyrolysis interactions and fluorine migration in photovoltaic laminates to inform recycling and pollutant management.

publications.title: Biochar confers significant microbial resistance to ammonia toxicity in n-caproic acid production
publications.authors: Benteng Wu, Richen Lin, Jing Gu, Haoran Yuan, Jerry D. Murphy

note.zh: 研究生物炭对氨胁迫下微生物链延长的促进作用，连接材料性质、电子传递与己酸生产。
note.en: Studies how biochar supports microbial chain elongation under ammonia stress, connecting materials, electron transfer and n-caproic acid production.

publications.title: An assessment of how the properties of pyrochar and process thermodynamics impact pyrochar mediated microbial chain elongation in steering the production of medium-chain fatty acids towards n-caproate
publications.authors: Benteng Wu, Richen Lin, Xue Ning, Xihui Kang, Chen Deng, Alan D. W. Dobson, Jerry D. Murphy

note.zh: 从热解炭性质与过程热力学出发，研究微生物链延长中己酸产率及选择性的调控。
note.en: Investigates how pyrochar properties and thermodynamics influence n-caproate yield and selectivity in microbial chain elongation.

publications.title: Improved robustness of ex-situ biological methanation for electro-fuel production through the addition of graphene
publications.authors: Benteng Wu, Richen Lin, Xihui Kang, Chen Deng, Alan D. W. Dobson, Jerry D. Murphy

note.zh: 研究石墨烯对间歇供气条件下异位生物甲烷化稳定性的影响。
note.en: Investigates graphene-assisted robustness of ex-situ biomethanation under intermittent gas supply.

publications.title: Production of advanced fuels through integration of biological, thermo-chemical and power to gas technologies in a circular cascading bio-based system
publications.authors: Benteng Wu, Richen Lin, Richard O’Shea, Chen Deng, Karthik Rajendran, Jerry D. Murphy

note.zh: 探讨生物转化、热化学与电转气技术集成的循环生物系统。
note.en: Explores a circular bio-based system integrating biological, thermochemical and power-to-gas technologies.

publications.title: Graphene addition to digestion of thin stillage can alleviate acidic shock and improve biomethane production
publications.authors: Benteng Wu, Richen Lin, Xihui Kang, Chen Deng, Ao Xia, Alan D. W. Dobson, Jerry D. Murphy

note.zh: 研究石墨烯对稀酒糟厌氧消化酸冲击恢复及生物甲烷生产的影响。
note.en: Examines graphene addition for recovery from acidic shock and biomethane production during thin stillage digestion.

publications.authors: Zhu, Xingyu Wu, Benteng Gu, Jing Fang, Qingyan Wu, Libin Yuan, Haoran

publications.authors: Zhu, Xingyu Wu, Benteng Cheng, Yangjuan Li, Nian Kang, Xihui Gu, Jing Yuan, Haoran

text.zh: 欢迎对上述研究方向感兴趣的同学联系交流。请通过工作邮箱介绍您的教育背景、研究兴趣，并附个人简历。具体招生安排以当年度官方通知及邮件确认为准。
text.en: Students interested in these research areas are welcome to get in touch. Please email a brief introduction, your research interests and your CV. Admission arrangements are subject to the relevant official announcements and confirmation by email.
